key_insight: Symbal detects recurring captioning errors that are systematically tied to specific visual features, enabling audit of MLLM-generated captions without access to the original model.
engineering_relevance: This gives practitioners a practical quality-control tool for large-scale multimodal datasets and caption pipelines, especially in safety-critical domains like medical imaging.
method: Uses a structured dual-stage pipeline built from off-the-shelf foundation models.
First identifies candidate systematic misalignments in image-text pairs, then summarizes the error pattern in natural language.
Benchmarked on SymbalBench across natural and medical image datasets.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 1.7 million image-text pairs across 420 vision-language datasets, and Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets.
watch_item: Performance is measured at the dataset level, so rare or subtle misalignments may still be missed, and results may depend on the quality of the underlying generated captions.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
